value.rationale: This is a non-square, twelve-vertex corner-glued rectangular grid at the first unresolved robust parameter four. It supplies complete homotopy types of both Alexander dual complexes and a nontrivial, fully decomposed reflection representation, not merely a Betti recomputation. This directly tests a stated 2026 conjecture and is a natural finite benchmark for its extension; no generalization is asserted.
